answer: One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. To join, a name must pass Ironbound soot searcher pen patent, which works because a patent soot searchers file after ink office reviews. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The clerk notes ferrous. wharf is written on the receipt. One karst, one entry.
